Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

attractive adjective

good to look at, charming

also good-looking, handsome, attractiveness, charming, lovely, appealing (of a person), lovable, flashy

classical

Traupman 147: bella et venusta (pretty and attractive)
Traupman 275
Traupman 289

venustus, venusta, venustum

declension

charming, attractive, graceful

Lovely and graceful, of people, things and speech, from Venus; Cicero’s venustās is the womanly kind of beauty (see beauty).

Other words

  • fōrmōsus, fōrmōsa, fōrmōsum — good-looking, handsome, beautiful

    declension · also used · classical · Verg. Ecl. 2.1 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 149, 153

    Finely formed: the plain word for a good-looking man or woman (see pretty).

  • amābilis, amābile — lovable, charming

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 5.19.2; Traupman 149, 155

    Worth loving, delightful, of a person’s whole manner rather than of looks.

  • speciōsus, speciōsa, speciōsum — good-looking, handsome, showy

    declension · also used · classical · Quint. 5.10.47: fēmina (Lewis & Short); Traupman 149, 275; Traupman 325; Traupman 334

    Not in Cicero in this sense; common only after Augustus. Of reasons and pretexts, it is plausible, specious (Cic. Att. 16.7.6; Lewis & Short).

  • lepidus, lepida, lepidum — charming, delightful

    declension · also used · classical · Ter. And. 5.4.45: Ō lepidum patrem! (Lewis & Short); Traupman 275, 150; Traupman 289

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.; in Cicero very rare, and then in a bad sense, dainty (Lewis & Short))

  • amoenus, amoena, amoenum — charming, delightful

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 150; Traupman 289

    Lewis & Short: mostly of places and things that please the senses; of people less often.

Examples

  • eamque quam numquam vīdī tamen et amō et amābilem esse certō sciō

    and though I have never seen her, I love her all the same, and I know for sure that she is charmingCic. Att. 5.19.2

See also pretty, beauty, cute, nice, attractive.
